title: No casualties reported in shanty town fire in southern Seoul
caption:
A fire erupted in Seoul's Guryong Village this afternoon. Emergency teams successfully evacuated 39 residents, and no casualties have been reported.

Source: Koreaherald - No casualties reported in shanty town fire in southern Seoul
